guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: emailservice shows the largest anomalies by far (latency-90 +36096%, z=+7219; cpu 0.31 -> 18.3, +5868%), and the downstream-most callers (checkoutservice latency-90 +663%) degrade while unrelated services (cartservice, adservice, productcatalogservice) stay flat. Memory also rose (+420%), but CPU is the far larger shift and logs show no errors, so cpu is the most likely fault, though mem cannot be fully excluded.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice pods for a CPU hotspot or runaway process, then raise the CPU limits/requests and scale out replicas. If the load persists, restart the affected emailservice pod after capturing a profile.
